info.title: ContextGatewayControlPlaneService
info.description:
Administration API for Context Gateway resources and their Upstreams.

Every write completes synchronously and returns the final state. Creating an
Upstream, changing its connection or authentication, and refreshing its catalog
run live discovery against the Upstream, bounded by the discovery timeout.
The tenant comes from the control-plane configuration, never from the request,
and no response shows it.

post.description:
Registers the Upstream, then discovers and publishes its first catalog. A failed
or timed-out initial discovery, or a failed tool generation, still creates the Upstream, with no activeCatalog,
and reports the failure in initialCatalogFailure.

delete.description:
Marks the Upstream as being deleted, which every reader treats as absent, then
releases its namespace, removes its catalogs and current credentials, deletes
the record, and removes its Gateway index entry last. A retry of an Upstream
that is being deleted resumes the cleanup and returns 204.

patch.description:
displayName and enabled are metadata-only and run no discovery. A change to
connection or authentication discovers with the candidate configuration, and a
contextSurface swaps the data model of a context-surface Upstream and generates
its catalog; either commits configuration and catalog together, or commits
nothing.

post.description:
Discovers with the current configuration and publishes every offered tool, only
if neither the configuration revision nor the active catalog revision changed
meanwhile. A 200 means the active catalog matches this discovery. Allowed on a
disabled Upstream.

get.description:
Lists every tool of the active catalog in one page, ordered by name, with no
paging. An Upstream with no published catalog answers an empty list. Each tool
shows the result of the cacheable rule and, only when one is stored, its policy.

ContextGatewayNotFoundErrorType.description:
Distinguish missing resources by type, never by human-readable title. A Gateway
ID owned by another tenant returns gateway-not-found with a body byte-identical
to an unknown Gateway ID, so the response never discloses that the ID exists.

ContextGatewayUnprocessableErrorResponse.description:
The request is well formed, but the work it asks for cannot succeed until the
rejected credentials are fixed: an mcp Upstream's credentials with an update,
or, for a context-surface Upstream, the Surface database login, which the
deployment administrator fixes in the Secret that supplies the deployment's
databases registry. Nothing was changed.

droppedToolPolicies.description:
The stored policies, or policy members, this update deleted, in tool name
order. Only a connection.endpoint change or a data model swap (contextSurface) that does not send toolPolicies
deletes any: it keeps each stored policy the new endpoint's catalog allows
and deletes the rest in the same commit as the new configuration. For a
tool the cacheable rule vetoes, only resultCache is deleted and
resultHandle stays stored. A policy is deleted whole only when the tool is
not in the catalog or nothing is left. Omitted when nothing was deleted.

cacheable.description:
The result of the cacheable rule, which reads only readOnlyHint and
destructiveHint. An absent hint vetoes nothing; an annotation never turns
caching on, only a resultCache policy does.
